market_summary: At 13:30 UTC during the London-NY overlap, a major US macroeconomic data release triggered intense volatility across all five tracked assets. Every market registered expanded ATRs, yellow RVOL spikes (or large intraday ranges on US100), and pronounced two-sided wicks. XAUUSD, EURUSD, and GBPUSD experienced aggressive upside liquidity sweeps that were sharply rejected back inside their respective session Value Areas, testing key VWAP and baseline supports. US100 surged to 28491 before retracing to its rising VWAP, while BTCUSD reclaimed its EMA50 amidst a sharp bearish CVD divergence. Given the whipsaw conditions and re-entry into Value Areas, all setups fail full confluence requirements, dictating disciplined HOLD across the entire portfolio.

signals.rationale: 1) Volume Profile: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 3884.20 to VAH 3908.89) and trading below POC (3895.22), testing VAL at live price 3884.80. 2) CVD: BEARISH at -5.16 with a negative slope (-1.68), indicating strong aggressive selling into the session. 3) Session: LONDON_NY_OVERLAP exhibiting high 13:30 UTC news volatility. 4) VWAP & EMA50: Price is below both VWAP (3899.35) and EMA50 (3895.80), with both baselines sloping downward. 5) ATR: Volatility is expanding (ATR 7.63); signal candle tested the upper ATR band (3906.90) while the forming bar swept below the lower ATR band (3876.40) to 3872.70 before rebounding. 6) RVOL: Yellow spike RVOL 2.803 confirms high-volume rejection off the highs. 7) S/R: Price swept liquidity above 3900 toward Session High 3922.99, then flushed down to sweep Session Low 3878.91 and S/R 3872.05. 8) GEX: Null. Massive two-sided wicks at VAL warrant holding.
